items.title: CPU backdoor research kit
items.oneliner: Proof-of-concept repo detects and exploits a VIA C3 hardware backdoor from userland, then shows how to disable it.

items.title: Syncthing runner for Android
items.oneliner: Minimal Android app runs Syncthing with battery and network rules, plus SD card support and zero telemetry.

items.title: Smart glasses sign translator
items.oneliner: Open-source demo turns fingerspelling into speech using smart glasses, a Python inference service, and a runnable web app.

items.title: Zig threaded IO deep dive
items.oneliner: Hands-on writeup explains cancellable blocking syscalls in Zig's Io.Threaded, with concrete concurrency tradeoffs systems engineers can apply.

items.title: Shell history shortcuts tutorial
items.oneliner: Quick tutorial shows bash and zsh event designators that eliminate repeated arguments and speed up terminal workflows immediately.

items.title: Encrypted DNS discovery guide
items.oneliner: Clear walkthrough explains DDR lookups for encrypted DNS, including the exact resolver records modern devices query automatically.

items.title: Database concurrency failure analysis
items.oneliner: Benchmark-backed case study shows how one long transaction collapsed MySQL throughput and which backpressure fixes restored stability.

items.title: CPU latency torture tests
items.oneliner: This repo measures worst-case single-instruction latency by weaponizing contention, exposing pathological CPU behavior normal benchmarks miss.

items.title: Control flow image generator
items.oneliner: DEF CON proof-of-concept turns images into executable control flow graphs that render inside IDA and other reverse engineering tools.

items.title: 486 core you can boot
items.oneliner: Verilog 486 SX core boots Linux and Windows 95 on FPGA, making it a practical reference for retro CPU builders.
